sub_graphs.title: Ethash: Proof-of-Work Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the hashimoto verification algorithm used to validate proof-of-work solutions

nodes.label: Block Header Received
nodes.description: Block header with nonce received for PoW verification

nodes.label: Compute Seed Hash
nodes.description: Create seed hash from header_hash concatenated with reversed nonce via keccak512

nodes.label: Seed Hash Ready
nodes.description: 64-byte seed hash computed

nodes.label: Initialize Mix Array
nodes.description: Duplicate seed hash across 128-byte mix width

nodes.label: Mix Array Initialized
nodes.description: 128-byte mix array ready for dataset access loop

nodes.label: Compute Dataset Index
nodes.description: Calculate index via FNV(iteration XOR seed_head, current_mix) mod dataset_size

nodes.label: Dataset Index Computed
nodes.description: Index into dataset determined for this iteration

nodes.label: Fetch Dataset Row
nodes.description: Retrieve 128-byte row from dataset at computed index

nodes.label: Dataset Row Fetched
nodes.description: Dataset row retrieved (2 rows per iteration, 64 iterations total)

nodes.label: FNV Combine Mix
nodes.description: Combine fetched data with mix using FNV hash function

nodes.label: Mix Updated
nodes.description: Mix array updated with dataset contribution

nodes.label: Compress Final Mix
nodes.description: FNV-combine 4-element groups to produce 32-byte mix digest

nodes.label: Mix Digest Ready
nodes.description: 32-byte compressed mix digest computed

nodes.label: Compute Final Hash
nodes.description: Compute keccak256(seed_hash || mix_digest)

nodes.label: PoW Result Ready
nodes.description: Final hash ready for difficulty comparison

nodes.label: Check Against Difficulty
nodes.description: Verify final hash <= target difficulty

nodes.label: Proof-of-Work Valid
nodes.description: Block passes PoW verification

nodes.label: Proof-of-Work Invalid
nodes.description: Block fails PoW verification

external_entities.name: Block Producer/Miner
external_entities.description: Entity that produces blocks with PoW solutions for verification

sub_graphs.title: Ethash: Epoch-Based Cache and Dataset Management
sub_graphs.description: Models the epoch transitions that trigger cache and dataset regeneration

nodes.label: Current Epoch Active
nodes.description: System operating with cache/dataset for current epoch

nodes.label: Check Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: Determine if block_number crosses 30,000 block boundary

nodes.label: Epoch Boundary Crossed
nodes.description: New epoch detected, regeneration required

nodes.label: Compute New Epoch Seed
nodes.description: Generate seed via iterative keccak256 based on epoch number

nodes.label: New Seed Ready
nodes.description: 32-byte epoch seed computed

nodes.label: Compute Cache Size
nodes.description: Calculate cache size: initial 2^24 + growth per epoch, find highest prime below

nodes.label: Cache Size Determined
nodes.description: Cache size for new epoch computed

nodes.label: Generate Cache
nodes.description: Build pseudorandom cache using keccak512 chain + 3 rounds RandMemoHash

nodes.label: Cache Generated
nodes.description: New epoch cache ready for use

nodes.label: Compute Dataset Size
nodes.description: Calculate dataset size: initial 2^30 + growth per epoch, find highest prime below

nodes.label: Dataset Size Determined
nodes.description: Dataset size for new epoch computed

nodes.label: Ready for New Epoch
nodes.description: All epoch parameters computed, system ready

sub_graphs.title: Ethash: Light Client Verification (Memory Optimization)
sub_graphs.description: Models the hashimoto_light function that generates dataset items on-the-fly from cache

nodes.label: Light Verification Requested
nodes.description: Block verification requested without full dataset in memory

nodes.label: Cache Available
nodes.description: Epoch cache is loaded (much smaller than full dataset)

nodes.label: Request Dataset Item
nodes.description: Hashimoto algorithm requests specific dataset index

nodes.label: Dataset Item Index Requested
nodes.description: Specific index needed for verification

nodes.label: Generate Item from Cache
nodes.description: Use generate_dataset_item to compute item from cache (256 parent accesses)

nodes.label: Dataset Item Generated
nodes.description: Dataset item computed on-the-fly

nodes.label: Return to Hashimoto
nodes.description: Provide generated item back to hashimoto verification loop

nodes.label: Verification Continues
nodes.description: Hashimoto continues with next iteration

external_entities.name: Light Client
external_entities.description: Resource-constrained node that verifies PoW without storing full dataset

ambiguities.text: The exact prime-finding algorithm for cache and dataset sizes is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard primality test is used to find highest prime below the linear growth target.

ambiguities.text: The FNV hash function is described as 'non-associative' without specifying exact parameters
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard FNV-1a parameters are used: prime 0x01000193, offset basis as per standard.

implicit_assumptions.description: ASICs cannot be built that efficiently compute Ethash due to memory hardness
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mining centralization, potential for 51% attacks by ASIC-equipped miners

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes have sufficient memory to store the cache (initial ~16MB, growing over time)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients unable to verify blocks, must trust full nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: The keccak256/keccak512 hash functions are cryptographically secure
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: PoW could be circumvented through hash function weaknesses

implicit_assumptions.description: Epoch transitions happen predictably every 30,000 blocks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners could be caught without updated cache/dataset at epoch boundaries
